_comment: Legitimate workflow security findings. Hard-capped at 20 entries (lint_workflow_security.py ALLOWLIST_CAP). Exceeding the cap signals the linter is wrong, not the content — tighten the heuristic, do not grow this list (autonomous-execution allowlist-growth antipattern). Each entry MUST cite why the finding is acceptable in `reason`. EMPTIED 2026-08-22 (road-to-ci-supply-chain-integrity 0.2). It held three mutable-action-tag exemptions for marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment and softprops/action-gh-release. All three are now pinned to full commit SHAs, so the findings they excused no longer exist and the entries matched nothing — lint_workflow_security reports "0 allowlisted". The roadmap step asked to REPAIR their `reason` text, each of which closed by naming an archived roadmap phase as the tracker for SHA-pinning; that phase is a git-discipline hook and its file mentions pinning nowhere, so the pointer dangled. Deleting a dead exemption is the honest repair — rewriting the reason on an entry that excuses nothing would have kept the allowlist looking load-bearing. The dangling pointer is also WHY the three survived: each one read as deferred rather than open. The full trace lives in the archived roadmap's completion note.
